$comment: Publish order for the no-drill wall-shelf pins. One pin is posted per scheduled run, top to bottom, skipping anything already on the board. board is created on first run if PINTEREST_BOARD_ID is unset.

board.name: Small Space Decor
board.description: Rent-safe storage and decor for small bedrooms. No drilling.

pins.title: 8 Damage-Free Shelves for a Rented Bedroom
pins.note: Eight shelves that work in a bedroom you do not own: adhesive strips, clear acrylic, an over-door rack, a tension pole that wedges floor to ceiling, and a caddy that clamps to the bed rail. Sizes and weight limits written out for each one. No drill for seven of the eight. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Command Decor Metal Shelf - Sticks On, No Drill
pins.note: A small metal wall shelf that goes up with Command strips instead of a drill. 4.8 x 4.0 in, rated to 5 lb, strips included. The one pick whose weight rating is measured on your wall rather than guessed. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Bedside Caddy That Hangs on the Bed Rail
pins.note: Five compartments that hook over the bed rail: phone, meds, cables, remote and a drink, off the floor and out of the drawer. Fits a rail up to 1.97 in across; 14.6 x 4.7 in overall. Nothing sticks to your wall at all. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Six Clear Acrylic Shelves - Tape or Screw
pins.note: A six-pack of see-through wall shelves, 15 x 4.2 in each, that nearly vanish on a pale wall. Rated 3 lb on adhesive tape and 20 lb when screwed. The pick for a bedroom where you do not want to see the storage. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Over-Door Rack: Storage With No Wall at All
pins.note: Five pockets and five mesh sides that hook over the top of a door, for bedrooms with no spare wall left. Doors up to 1.98 in thick; 44 lb stated by the listing. Zero contact with the wall, so nothing to patch. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Two Floating Shelves, Adhesive Tape Only
pins.note: The cheapest way into a wall shelf: two 4.7 x 8.6 in floating shelves that go up on adhesive tape, rated 4 lb per shelf. Good for a phone, a candle and a plant, not for a stack of books. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Tension Pole Shelves - Floor to Ceiling, No Fixings
pins.note: Four tiers held up by nothing but pressure between floor and ceiling. Fits a 15.4 to 27.2 in wide gap and a 4 to 10 ft height, and touches no wall at all. The most shelf you can get without fixing anything. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: Bedside Shelf That Clamps to the Bed Frame
pins.note: A 13 x 9.5 in tray that clamps onto the bed rail instead of the wall, for rooms with no bedside table. Clamps rails up to 2.9 in. Comes off when you move, and the wall never knew. Contains Amazon affiliate links.

pins.title: VASAGLE Ladder Shelf - The One You Do Anchor
pins.note: The exception in the list: four tiers, 22 x 13.6 in, 54.1 in tall, and it leans into the wall with the included anti-tip strap. That means one hole. Included because the storage is the best here and the trade-off is worth saying out loud. Contains Amazon affiliate links.
